title: EventBus delivery-time registry mutation stability contract

contract.delivery_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful when a listener mutates the listener registry during delivery
contract.listener_delivery: Listeners present for the delivery receive the emitted event despite registry mutation during callback execution
contract.mutation_tolerance: Selective unregister and re-registration performed during callback execution do not abort the current event delivery
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after delivery-time mutation
contract.registry_uniqueness: Delivery-time mutation does not create duplicate owner registrations
contract.order_boundary: Registry ordering may change when listeners are removed and re-registered during delivery; this observation does not establish order preservation under mutation
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the emitting plugin_id as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, re-registration, and emit operations require the events permission
